eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Registered/verified 1984 riot-affected family/widow on GNCTD Relief Branch records residing in Delhi (NCT).

benefit.summary_en: Monthly enhanced pension (historically ₹20,000/month per eligible family [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) for verified 1984 riot-affected families/widows in Delhi.

anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
